name: Persian relationship knowledge domain query
description: Tests the Persian offline knowledge shelf relationship domain. The user asks about relationships in Persian, then about emotional connection, then transitions to a personal loneliness topic. Verifies Persian knowledge responses from the relationship domain and smooth transition to conversational rules.
